theorem lg_target {y z : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hzy : z ≤ y) : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic y, f x = (∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iio z, f x) + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc z y, f x := by
  have h_partition : Set.Iic y = Set.Iio z ∪ Set.Icc z y :=
    by rw [Set.Iic_def, Set.Iio_def, Set.Icc_def]; exact Set.union_Iio_Icc z y
  have h_disjoint : Disjoint Set.Iio z Set.Icc z y := by apply Set.disjoint_Iio_Icc
  have h_meas : MeasurableSet (Set.Iio z) ∧ MeasurableSet (Set.Icc z y) :=
    by exact (measurable_Iio _).prod (measurable_Icc _ _)
  have h_add : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic y, f x = ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iio z, f x + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc z y, f x :=
    by apply measure_theory.integral_add; exact h_partition; exact h_disjoint; exact h_meas
  exact h_add
